answer_card.title: Create an EDA credential type
answer_card.answer_md:
*Automation Decisions > Infrastructure > Credential Types > Create credential type*

Input configuration:
```yaml
fields:
  - type: string
    id: username
    label: Username
  - type: string
    id: password
    label: Password
    secret: true
required:
  - username
  - password
```
Injector configuration:
```json
{
  "extra_vars": {
    "some_extra_var": "{{ username }}:{{ password }}"
  }
}
```
